title: CPF Module Schema: Event Hub Namespace module
description: JSON schema for CPF module 'cpf-azure-prdsvc-eventhubnamespace'. Use this to generate Terraform code that calls the CPF module.

app_id.description: (Required) A descriptive name (abbreviation) for the workload (application) as it is registered in Leanix. The identifier format in Leanix is 'APP-12345', for the purpose of naming resources only 5 number will be used.

authorization_rules.type: map(object({ name = string listen = optional(bool, false) send = optional(bool, false) manage = optional(bool, false) }))
authorization_rules.description: (Optional) A map of Event Hub Namespace Authorization Rules configuation objects as defined below: object({ name = "(Required) Specifies the name of the Authorization Rule." listen = "(Optional) Grants listen access to this this Authorization Rule." send = "(Optional) Grants send access to this this Authorization Rule." manage = "(Optional) Grants manage access to this this Authorization Rule. When this property is true - both listen and send must be too." })

auto_inflate_enabled.description: (Optional) Is Auto Inflate enabled for the EventHub Namespace?

capacity.description: (Optional) Specifies the Capacity / Throughput Units for a Standard SKU namespace. Default capacity has a maximum of 2, but can be increased in blocks of 2 on a committed purchase basis. Defaults to 1.

cmk_key_name.description: (optional) Key name to be used (max 127 chars)

cmk_rotation_policy.type: object({ notify_before_expiry = string time_before_expiry = string time_after_creation = optional(string, null) expire_after = string })
cmk_rotation_policy.description: (Optional) A rotation policy block as defined below object({ notify_before_expiry = "(Optional) Expire a Key Vault Key after given duration as an ISO 8601 duration." time_before_expiry = "(Optional) Rotate automatically at a duration before expiry as an ISO 8601 duration." time_after_creation = "(Optional) Rotate automatically at a duration before expiry as an ISO 8601 duration." expire_after = "(Optional) Expire a Key Vault Key after given duration as an ISO 8601 duration." })

context.description: (Optional) Application context information for the resource(s) (max 10 chars).

create_role_assignment.description: Whether to create the Key Vault Crypto Service Encryption User role assignment. Set to false if the role assignment already exists.

customer_managed_key.type: object({ key_vault_id = string expiration_date = string identity_id = optional(string, null) identity_principal_id = optional(string, null) infrastructure_encryption_enabled = bool use_system_assigned_identity = bool })
customer_managed_key.description: (Required) An customer_managed_key block as defined below object({ key_vault_id = "(Required) The resource ID of the Key Vault where the Key Vault Key resides." expiration_date = "(Required) Expiration UTC datetime (Y-m-d'T'H:M:S'Z')." identity_id = "(Optional) The resource ID of the User Assigned Identity that has access to the key. Required if `use_system_assigned_identity` is set to false." identity_principal_id = "(Optional) The principal ID of the User Assigned Identity that has access to the key. Required if `use_system_assigned_identity` is set to false." infrastructure_encryption_enabled = "(Required) Used to specify whether enable Infrastructure Encryption (Double Encryption). Changing this forces a new resource to be created." use_system_assigned_identity = "(Required) Indicate that system assigned identity should be used for CMK or not. Defaults to `false`" })

dedicated_cluster_id.description: (Optional) Specifies the ID of the EventHub Dedicated Cluster where this Namespace should created. Changing this forces a new resource to be created.

disaster_recovery_config.type: object({ secondary_region = string secondary_resource_group_name = string identity = object({ type = optional(string, "SystemAssigned") identity_ids = optional(list(string), null) }) customer_managed_key = object({ identity_id = optional(string, null) identity_principal_id = optional(string, null) }) network_rulesets = optional(object({ default_action = optional(string, "Allow") trusted_service_access_enabled = optional(bool, true) virtual_network_rule = optional(list(object({ subnet_id = string ignore_missing_virtual_network_service_endpoint = optional(bool, true) })), []) ip_rule = optional(list(object({ ip_mask = string action = optional(string, "Allow") })), []) }), { default_action = "Allow" trusted_service_access_enabled = true virtual_network_rule = [] ip_rule = [] }) })
disaster_recovery_config.description: (Optional) A disaster recovery configuration block as defined below. These value are required only when you need to create a secondary Event Hub Namespace for the Disaster Recovery. object({ secondary_region = "(Required) The name of the Azure region where the secondary event hub namespace will be created. Please choose among the reginal pairs only. identity = object({ type = "(Optional) Specifies the type of Managed Service Identity that should be configured on this Event Hub Namespace. Possible values are `SystemAssigned` or `UserAssigned`. Defaults to `SystemAssigned`" identity_ids = "(Optional) Specifies a list of User Assigned Managed Identity IDs to be assigned to this EventHub namespace." }) customer_managed_key = object({ identity_id = "(Optional) The resource ID of the User Assigned Identity that has access to the key. Required if `use_system_assigned_identity` is set to false." identity_principal_id = "(Optional) The principal ID of the User Assigned Identity that has access to the key. Required if `use_system_assigned_identity` is set to false." }) }) network_rulesets = object({ default_action = "(Optional) The default action of the network ruleset. Possible values are `Allow` and `Deny`. Defaults to `Allow`." trusted_service_access_enabled = "(Optional) Whether Trusted Microsoft Services are allowed to bypass firewall. Defaults to true." virtual_network_rule = "(Optional) A list of Virtual Network Rule objects as defined below." list(object({ subnet_id = "(Required) The ID of the Subnet to which this Virtual Network Rule applies." ignore_missing_virtual_network_service_endpoint = "(Optional) Whether to ignore missing Virtual Network Service Endpoint. Defaults to true." })) ip_rule = "(Optional) A list of IP Rule objects as defined below." list(object({ ip_mask = "(Required) The IP Mask to which this IP Rule applies." action = "(Optional) The action of the IP Rule. Possible values are `Allow` and `Deny`. Defaults to `Allow`." })) })

environment.description: (Required) The environment where the resource is deployed. Given as abbreviation to leave more characters to the other naming components (max 3 chars).

identity.description: (Optional) An identity block as defined below object({ type = "(Required) Specifies the type of Managed Service Identity that should be configured on this Event Hub Namespace. Possible values are SystemAssigned or UserAssigned." identity_ids = "(Optional) Specifies a list of User Assigned Managed Identity IDs to be assigned to this EventHub namespace." })

instance.description: (Optional) Instance number, if context includes/requires multiple resources of the same type (max 3 int).

key_vault_tags.description: (Optional) Key Vault related tags to be set on key vault child resources.

local_authentication_enabled.description: (Optional) Enable or disable local authentication for Event Hub Namespace. Defaults to false.

maximum_throughput_units.description: (Optional) Specifies the maximum number of throughput units when Auto Inflate is Enabled. Valid values range from 1 - 20.

minimum_tls_version.description: (Optional) The minimum supported TLS version for this EventHub Namespace. Valid values are: 1.0, 1.1 and 1.2. Defaults to 1.2.

namespace_schema_group.type: map(object({ name = string schema_compatibility = optional(string, "Backward") schema_type = optional(string, "Avro") }))
namespace_schema_group.description: (Optional) A map of Event Hub Namespace Schema Group objects as defined below: object({ name = "(Required) Specifies the name of this schema group. Changing this forces a new resource to be created." schema_compatibility = "(Optional) Specifies the compatibility of this schema group. Possible values are `None`, `Backward`, `Forward`." schema_type = "(Optional) Specifies the Type of this schema group. Possible values are `Avro`, `Unknown`." })

network_rulesets.type: object({ default_action = optional(string, "Allow") trusted_service_access_enabled = optional(bool, true) virtual_network_rule = optional(list(object({ subnet_id = string ignore_missing_virtual_network_service_endpoint = optional(bool, true) })), []) ip_rule = optional(list(object({ ip_mask = string action = optional(string, "Allow") })), []) })
network_rulesets.description: (Optional) An object of network_rulesets block as defined below. object({ default_action = "(Optional) The default action of the network ruleset. Possible values are `Allow` and `Deny`. Defaults to `Allow`." trusted_service_access_enabled = "(Optional) Whether Trusted Microsoft Services are allowed to bypass firewall. Defaults to true." virtual_network_rule = "(Optional) A list of Virtual Network Rule objects as defined below." list(object({ subnet_id = "(Required) The ID of the Subnet to which this Virtual Network Rule applies." ignore_missing_virtual_network_service_endpoint = "(Optional) Whether to ignore missing Virtual Network Service Endpoint. Defaults to true." })) ip_rule = "(Optional) A list of IP Rule objects as defined below." list(object({ ip_mask = "(Required) The IP Mask to which this IP Rule applies." action = "(Optional) The action of the IP Rule. Possible values are `Allow` and `Deny`. Defaults to `Allow`." })) })

public_network_access_enabled.description: (Optional) Enable or disable public network access for Event Hub Namespace. Defaults to false.

resource_group_name.description: (Required) Name of the Resource Group in which to create the resource.

sku.description: (Optional) Defines which tier to use. Valid options are Basic, Standard, and Premium. Please note that setting this field to Premium will force the creation of a new resource.

tags.description: (Optional) Tags to be set on each resource.

trusted_service_access_enabled.description: (Optional) Whether Trusted Microsoft Services are allowed to bypass firewall.

default_primary_connection_string.description: The Event Hub Namespace default primary connection string.

id.description: The ID of the created Event Hub Namespace.

name.description: The name of the created Event Hub Namespace.

secondary_id.description: The ID of the Service Bus Namespace created.

agent_instructions.summary: To provision 'Eventhubnamespace' via Terraform, call this CPF module with the inputs defined below. Required inputs have no default and must be provided.
agent_instructions.module_type_notes: This is a single-service CPF module. It provisions one Azure resource type.
